kinds.d: Device that guides or stimulates pelvic-floor muscle exercise, sold for continence or postnatal recovery.
Smooth cylinder, usually sold as a graduated set, used to widen or restore vaginal capacity after surgery, radiotherapy or for vaginismus.
Cylinder and pump that draws blood into the penis to produce an erection, sold to treat erectile dysfunction.

kinds.a: ED ring · constriction ring · tension ring
kinds.d: Elastic ring worn at the base of the penis to keep an erection, often used with a vacuum erection device.
Device worn to apply steady stretch to the penis, sold for Peyronie's disease or to preserve length after surgery.

Pelvic-floor trainer: the biofeedback and stimulation variants were added as t types; both models kept. Vaginal dilator: all 4 brands kept as market-covering, reordered with Owen Mumford (Amielle) first. Set, single, silicone and plastic variants went into t. Penile traction device: still has no models. The old source (osbon.ca) names no traction model, and adding makers is outside this restraint-only pass. All old s URLs kept.
